acceptance_progress.behavior: Agent tool dispatch has a bounded elapsed-time budget and existing step ceiling; cooperative handlers can check the host-owned deadline before another effect.
Explicit AUTH_REQUIRED, NOT_AVAILABLE, SOURCE_CHANGED, and REVIEW_REQUIRED outcomes stop the run; append-only trace stores the terminal reason and sanitized duration consumption.

A host-declared collection contract checks output structure, stated and expected counts, empty/unknown results, required fields, and the expected tail item; unknown or incomplete output cannot be reported as successful.

environment.persistence_test: temporary SQLite database with close/reopen trace readback
environment.browser: NOT_RUN; this agent runtime does not expose a browser adapter
environment.postgresql: NOT_RUN; no PostgreSQL-specific behavior or migration changed

remaining_acceptance: Connect the run contract to actual browser/source collection entrypoints and verify it with a controlled browser flow.
Add page-count budgets and bounded slice re-runs for flakiness diagnosis.
A synchronous tool handler already in progress cannot be forcibly terminated; handlers must check the host deadline cooperatively before additional work.
